name: config

ops.description: Write operations, one flat object per op, run in order. A field marked [ops: ...] applies only to the ops named.

rootId.description: Project root item (depth 0): a UUID or a hex prefix of 8 to 32 characters.

version.description: Config version number, 1 or greater. [ops: get, rollback]

fingerprint.description: Content fingerprint to classify against the root's history; adds relation: current, superseded or unknown. [ops: get]

before.description: Page back: only versions below this number (exclusive); pass the last version of the previous page. [ops: history]

configYaml.description: The config document, YAML text of at most 131072 bytes. [ops: push, validate]

force.description: Skip the project.rootId mismatch and older-content guards (default false). Never skips validation or expectedVersion. [ops: push]

expectedVersion.description: Compare-and-set: the head version this write expects, 1 or greater. A different head is version_conflict; force does not skip it. [ops: push, rollback]

key.description: Rule key: lowercase letters, digits, dot, underscore or hyphen, starting alphanumeric, at most 100 characters. [ops: rules]

itemId.description: Item whose effective schema holds noteKey: a UUID or a hex prefix of 8 to 32 characters. A root item is its own root. [ops: rules]

noteKey.description: Note key looked up in itemId's effective schema; its skill field names the rule key. [ops: rules]

idempotencyKey.description: Optional client key (1-128 chars, needs actor). Resending the same op with the same key returns the stored result.

atomic.description: true: the first failing op rolls back the whole batch. Default false: each op commits on its own.

describe.description: true: return the operations, their parameters and errors instead of running the tool.

description: Per-root config and rules. Each ops[] element has an op: get, history, push, validate, rollback, reset (a root's versioned config document), effective (the resolved view), or rules (rule text). Reads need the read capability, push, rollback and reset the write-config capability. rootId is a depth-0 item. Call with describe:true for each operation's parameters and errors.
